title: Flagging Batch Shift in Flow Cytometry using Jeffreys Divergence between Gaussian Mixtures
abstract: arXiv:2611.31321v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning models for clinical flow cytometry are usually evaluated on data drawn from their training distribution. In routine practice, however, acquisition conditions and reagents may change, potentially making predictions unreliable without warning. We propose a model agnostic criterion for prediction reliability based on a notion of distance from the training distribution: each patient sample is represented by a Gaussian mixture model, and its Jeffreys divergence to a reference fitted on the training data is estimated using Monte Carlo integration. We illustrate our approach on real-life shifted cohorts of acute myeloid leukaemia patients, using a classifier trained to predict NPM1 mutation status. First, we show graphically and statistically that pairwise divergences capture acquisition cohort structure. We then calibrate a rejection threshold on a subset of shifted cohort samples and evaluate it on held-out subjects. Across 2

translated_title: 利用高斯混合模型间的Jeffreys散度标记流式细胞术中的批次偏移
translated_abstract: 用于临床流式细胞术的机器学习模型通常在来自其训练分布的数据上进行评估。然而在日常实践中，采集条件和试剂可能会发生变化，从而可能在毫无预警的情况下使预测变得不可靠。我们提出了一种与模型无关的预测可靠性判据，其基于与训练分布之间距离的概念：每个患者样本用一个高斯混合模型来表示，并通过蒙特卡洛积分估计其与在训练数据上拟合的参考模型之间的Jeffreys散度。我们在急性髓系白血病患者的真实偏移队列上展示了我们的方法，所用分类器经过训练以预测NPM1突变状态。首先，我们从图形和统计上证明成对散度能够捕捉采集队列的结构。随后，我们在偏移队列样本的一个子集上校准拒绝阈值，并在留出的受试者上进行评估。在2（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种基于高斯混合模型间Jeffreys散度的与模型无关的方法，用于检测流式细胞术数据中的批次偏移并标记不可靠的预测。
